CALLS | request and history-side operation
CanvasViewControls.command() [CanvasViewControls.tsx]
  |-- settlePendingGesture()
  `-- onCommand(CanvasViewRequest)
       supplies requestId and expectedVersion
CanvasViewReceiver.apply() [canvasViewReceiver.ts]
  |-- canvasViewRequestSchema.parse(raw)
  |-- list/read -> controller.canvasView()
  `-- mutation receipt keyed by documentId + requestId
       |-- controller.canvasView(expectedVersion, input)
       `-- persist(); retry same request if save is pending
History-side entry: CanvasHistory.canvasView()
  |-- open -> openCanvasView() -> stashCanvasView()
  |-- create/fork/alternatives -> saved-view metadata
  `-- save/keep/discard -> endpoints or archive state
